{{Quote|<nowiki />''Skywalker'' again! ''He's'' the one who stopped us in the Styx system.|A enslaver in Luke Skywalker's dream|<ref name="Star Wars 17">[[Star Wars (1977) 17|''Star Wars'' (1977) 17]]</ref>}}
The '''Styx system''' was located in the [[Baxel sector/Legends|Baxel sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> within [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> In his [[Youngling/Legends|youth]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Farm/Legends|farmboy]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] [[Dream/Legends|dreamed]] of battling [[Slaver/Legends|enslavers]]. In one such daydream, one of the enslavers that Skywalker imagined fighting recalled the latter's stopping them in the Styx [[Star system/Legends|system]].<ref name="Star Wars 17" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Styx system was first mentioned in the [[Star Wars (1977) 17|seventeenth]] issue of the [[Star Wars (1977)|''Star Wars'']] [[Star Wars comic books|comic series]], which was written by [[Archie Goodwin]] and [[Chris Claremont]]<ref name="Star Wars 17" /> and published by [[Marvel Comics]] on [[July 25]], [[1978]].<ref name="Marvel date">''[[Star Wars Year By Year: A Visual History, Updated and Expanded Edition]]''</ref> ''Star Wars'' 17's mention only occurred in a dream, leaving the system's [[in-universe]] existence ambiguous<ref name="Star Wars 17" /> until the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' confirmed it. The book also placed the system in grid square U-11.<ref name="TEA" />
